messages:
claire: Hey team — opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6201 to add the private-deploy KMS example. It's marked 'sensitive' because it references customer-managed KMS config. Need cross-team redaction + legal signoff before merging. Can security/legal take a look?
ben: Thanks — quick note: the PR includes a code snippet with a fake key that we should redact just in case. I left a comment on the PR.
claire: Yep, saw that. I replaced the literal with `<<KMS_KEY_PLACEHOLDER>>` in the branch but left the original in the commit history — do we need a history scrub or is a follow-up internal note ok?
security-team: @claire thanks. For public docs we require both the snippet redacted and a GH history rewrite if the key looks real or matches any internal pattern. Can you paste the exact snippet here?
claire: snippet: ```yaml
kms:
  key: "AKIA12345EXAMPLE"
  region: "us-west-2"
```
sam: Ack — that definitely matches our rotate pattern, treat as sensitive. We should scrub commit and request a force-push with a rewritten commit. I can help if you want.
ben: Link fix FYI — the migration guide anchor changed and CI preview is failing with a 404 in docs-preview. I've pushed a tiny change to fix that in the same branch to avoid multiple PRs.
ci-bot: docs-preview build started: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/preview/6201 (job 442)
docs-bot: Automatic checklist: [x] grammar checks, [ ] link checks, [ ] security review requested.
legal-reviews: @claire quick Q: does the content include any customer PII or contractual wording? If not, redaction + security signoff should be enough.
claire: No PII or contract text. It's an example config only.
security-team: Ok. Steps we need: 1) scrub commit history (we can walk you through git filter-branch / filter-repo), 2) replace snippet with `<<KMS_KEY_PLACEHOLDER>>`, 3) add a small note in the PR description saying 'redaction scrubbed on DATE by SECURITY', 4) security ack in thread.
sam: I'm available to help with the scrub. If you want I can do it and push a clean branch; will preserve the PR. Say the word.
claire: Please do, that would be great — I'm mid-context switch. Do you need temporary MFA/ssh?
sam: No access changes needed, I'll fork, run git-filter-repo locally, and force-push to your branch. Will ping when done. ETA ~30m.
ci-bot: docs-preview build failed: 1 broken link (migration guide anchor).
ben: I already pushed the anchor fix, that should rerun once the branch updates.
ci-bot: Requeued build (after push).
docs-bot: Note: if we rewrite history GH will show a force-push; add a reviewer comment to explain.
sam: Done rewrite, force-pushed. New head: commit 9f4c2b3 (redacted snippet + link fix).
ci-bot: docs-preview build started: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/preview/6201 (job 443)
security-team: Reviewed the preview, snippet redacted looks good. Confirming no secrets in rendered pages. :white_check_mark:
legal-reviews: Reviewed copy for compliance — no legal flags. Recommend mentioning in the PR that the example is illustrative and not to paste keys.
ben: Added small disclaimer sentence.
claire: Thanks everyone. Does this meet merge timing? We want to merge before tomorrow's deploy cutoff at 17:00 PST.
security-team: We're good on our side.
legal-reviews: Good from legal.
ben: CI green. docs-preview looks correct.
docs-bot: Merge checklist complete.
claire: Merging now. :sparkles: Thanks all for quick turnaround.
ci-bot: Merge completed by claire — PR #6201 merged to main.
